summary: Final acceptance does not pass at dc9d39dac, for two procedural reasons. The work itself meets every spec criterion. First, Phase 1 has no phase-acceptance result: results exist for Phases 2, 3 and 4 only. Second, the Phase 4 result audited d2c8e6336, and the later commits change 8 track paths that are not plan or evidence files, so they are not covered by the path-diff rule. Review A and the adversarial pass both passed at dc9d39dac, which mitigates the second gap. All four gates passed on a fresh run at HEAD: check-types, lint (0 errors, 3 known warnings), Vitest (98 files, 1413 tests) and coverage (92.08 % lines). The case cut is 55.5 % (3175 to 1413) and the coverage rise is 5.56 points. No production file was changed by the pilot. Two procedural actions close the track: run the missing phase acceptance, or record a PM exception for each gap.

Fix: run phase acceptance for Phase 4 at dc9d39dac, or record a PM exception that accepts those two passes as the cover.
